defs.def: to make a feeling, an idea, etc. stronger 加强；充实；使更强烈

ex.s: It can also be used to reinforce the meanings of themes: in the title The Importance of Being Earnest, “Earnest” is an adjective as well as a character’s name.
ex.t: 也可以用来强化主题的含义:在标题 " 成为收入者的重要性 " 中, " Earnest " 是形容词和人物的名字。

ex.s: Whenever you make a choice, your character is reinforced, or changes, or grows, or diminishes, depending on whether the decision you made is wise or foolish, good or bad.
ex.t: 每当你做出选择时，你的品格就会得到加强、改变、成长或削弱，这取决于你做的决定是明智还是愚蠢，是好还是坏。

defs.def: to make a structure or material stronger, especially by adding another material to it 加固；使更结实
to send more people or equipment in order to make an army, etc. stronger 给 … 加强力量（或装备）；使更强大
